sources.label: NFT marketplace sales
sources.note: Verified successful Purchased events from the production NFT checkout, reconciled to actual receipts in the shop wallet. Internal company purchases are listed as transfers instead of new revenue.

transferSources.label: NFT wallet transfers (not revenue)
transferSources.note: Successful native and recognised-token movements into and out of the shop wallet. Transfers are retained for reconciliation and never counted as fresh revenue. Unpriced token movements retain their original amounts.

valuation: BUSD and USDT are booked at their $1 face value. BNB uses the Binance BNBUSDT close on the UTC day. The two original DeHub purchases use the historical DeHub/WBNB pool reserves at the purchase block and that day’s BNB close. Other DeHub/DHB wallet movements remain unpriced and excluded from revenue totals.
notes: The retained operating funds were fully reinvested, as reported by DeHub. Marketing and developer wages are shown together rather than allocating an unsupported split.
Direct wallet movements, staking rewards, swaps and internal company purchases are not new NFT sales. Outgoing transfers are not automatically classified as refunds.
